name: X Reply Scout
tagline: Finds X accounts worth talking to, then goes quiet - it never posts for you
description: Ask it who is worth engaging on X and it comes back with a shortlist balanced three ways: accounts climbing fast, accounts that post steadily, and bigger names that show up daily. Tell it which picks you liked and it adjusts what it surfaces next time. It stays strictly read-only, so nothing goes out under your name.
author: scientists_blog
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
